title: action_press and action_release have timing issues with is_action_pressed, is_action_just_pressed and is_action_just_released
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.4.1.stable.official

### Issue description

Consider this simple test script:
```gdscript
extends Node

var frame := -1

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if frame == 0:
		Input.action_press("ui_up")
	if frame == 10:
		Input.action_release("ui_up")
	
	if frame <= 12:
		print(frame, 
			" pressed = ", Input.is_action_pressed("ui_up"),
			" just_pressed = true" if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up") else "",
			" just_released = true" if Input.is_action_just_released("ui_up") else "")
	
	frame += 1
```

I would expect Input.is_action_just_pressed to return true on the first tick that Input.is_action_pressed returns true and Input.is_action_just_released to return true on the first tick that Input.is_action_pressed returns false.

Instead, it seems that the Input.is_action_just_* functions are delayed by one tick, because this script produes the following output:
```
-1 pressed = false
0 pressed = true
1 pressed = true just_pressed = true
2 pressed = true
3 pressed = true
4 pressed = true
5 pressed = true
6 pressed = true
7 pressed = true
8 pressed = true
9 pressed = true
10 pressed = false
11 pressed = false just_released = true
12 pressed = false
```

### Steps to reproduce

See above.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Just create an empty scene and attach the test script to the root node.
